system.description:
Range 30ft; up to 1 creature per two levels (max 10). Each is restored to its maximum HP minus 1d4, and its Blinded, Deafened and Stunned conditions and diseases end. Cast reversed (Mass Harm): each target makes a Fortitude save or is reduced to 1d4 HP; on a success it loses half its current HP. Undead are healed by Mass Harm, harmed by Mass Heal.

Reversible: may be cast as its opposite with the same slot.

Classes: Cleric, Witch
system.saveEffect: Loses half its current HP instead (Mass Harm only)
